north_star: ONE STUDENT → ONE ID → ONE HISTORY → MANY ACTIVITIES → ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH → MANY REPORTS.
progress_model: Eight baseline student-development domains are the system delivery denominator. Shared Core/AI/Communication/Parent Portal/reporting are tracked separately to avoid double counting.

modules.name: Akademik
modules.source_of_truth: Academic domain transactions linked to Student_ID

modules.name: Administratif & Layanan

shared_workstreams.name: Shared Core
shared_workstreams.notes: Canonical Student, Guardian, Staff, Organization, identity lifecycle and shared contracts are specified in docs/10_shared_core. Implementation remains incremental through Sprint 0–1.

shared_workstreams.name: Shared Platform
shared_workstreams.notes: Laravel/PostgreSQL runtime, queues/jobs, logging, backup/recovery, notifications and common infrastructure.

shared_workstreams.name: Cross-Domain Reporting / Student 360
shared_workstreams.notes: Derived consumer layer only; never a source of truth.

shared_workstreams.name: IMTAQ AI Assistant
shared_workstreams.notes: Provider-neutral optional AI layer; implementation deferred until trustworthy domain foundations exist.

shared_workstreams.name: Communication & WhatsApp
shared_workstreams.notes: Provider-neutral Parent + institutional communication layer: announcements, reminders, action requests, staff/Guardian audience resolution, templates, queues, WhatsApp adapter, structured responses, delivery events and audit. Teacher availability confirmation is readiness context only. Implementation deferred.

shared_workstreams.name: Parent Portal
shared_workstreams.notes: Guardian-facing authenticated read surface for exact published parent-approved artifacts. Depends on Shared Core Guardian identity, Shared Platform auth/RBAC/audit and source reporting; implementation deferred.
